place-field.title: Commons Field
place-field.what: The open center of Eden: a place to meet outdoors, with the pavilion, shared kitchen and nearby pond at its edges.

place-eden-east.title: Eden Village
place-eden-east.what: The compact village east of Commons Field, bringing homes, the library, classroom, café, market and music room within a short walk.

place-eden-housing.title: Eden Courtyard Homes
place-eden-housing.what: Four courtyard homes in the village, with separate living spaces, kitchens, bedrooms and studies. House numbers distinguish the homes and their rooms.

place-region-canal-quarter.title: Canal Quarter
place-region-canal-quarter.what: A narrow canal runs between two rows of homes and long quays. Two bridges connect the banks; allotments lie along the western side.

place-region-old-town.title: Old Town
place-region-old-town.what: A civic quarter around a broad plaza, with a domed hall, bell tower and arcaded streets. Market Street leads toward the seafront.

place-region-park.title: Town Park
place-region-park.what: A public green with a pond, gazebo, playground and ice-cream stalls. It is a place for a short walk, play or a seated break south of the Commons.

place-region-sports-ground.title: Sports Ground
place-region-sports-ground.what: The recreation grounds beside Town Park, with a football pitch, tennis courts and a clubhouse.

place-region-farm-hamlet.title: Farm Hamlet
place-region-farm-hamlet.what: The small farming settlement west of Town Park: a farmhouse, barn and windmill overlook wheat and vegetable plots.

place-region-harbour.title: Harbour
place-region-harbour.what: Eden’s working waterfront on the southern sea. Follow the boardwalk to the fish market, the west and east piers, or the lighthouse beyond.

place-region-seaside-resort.title: Seaside Resort
place-region-seaside-resort.what: The leisure waterfront east of the harbour, with hotels, a beach, amusement rides and a marina.

place-region-vineyard.title: Vineyard
place-region-vineyard.what: Rows of vines and an orchard surround the villa and wine cellar north of the village. The villa tower distinguishes this rural estate from the nearby campus.

place-region-campsite.title: Woodland Campsite
place-region-campsite.what: A lodge and six tents gather around a fire circle among the woods north of West Lake.

place-region-railway-station.title: Railway Station
place-region-railway-station.what: The station building, platform and train area form the rail stop north of the Canal Quarter. The platform is distinct from the indoor station rooms.

place-region-makers-yard.title: Makers’ Yard
place-region-makers-yard.what: A cluster of workshops and greenhouses north of the railway station, for making, repair and growing.

place-region-abbey.title: Abbey Grounds
place-region-abbey.what: The church and cloister stand among lavender and kitchen gardens. The cloister offers quieter domestic rooms away from the main church.

place-region-courtyard-quarter.title: Courtyard Quarter
place-region-courtyard-quarter.what: Four courtyard houses form a small residential neighbourhood between the Commons and the Abbey. Use the house number to distinguish their kitchens, studies and bedrooms.

place-region-botanic-garden.title: Botanic Garden
place-region-botanic-garden.what: A garden of specimen planting, a koi pond and red bridge, with a pagoda, palm house and tea pavilion. The gravel court offers a quieter corner.

place-region-observatory.title: Northern Observatory
place-region-observatory.what: The observatory grounds above the vineyard, marked by the dome. This destination is distinct from the smaller observatory in Eden Village.

place-region-west-river.title: West River Valley
place-region-west-river.what: The long river corridor at the western edge of Eden, with a stone bridge, watermill and fishing hamlet along its banks.

place-region-east-crossroads.title: East Crossroads
place-region-east-crossroads.what: A roadside stop on the eastern edge of town, with a petrol station, pub and beer garden.

place-region-golf-course.title: Golf Course
place-region-golf-course.what: The landscaped golf grounds north of the eastern settlements, with a clubhouse and a small water hazard.

place-region-festival-meadow.title: Festival Meadow
place-region-festival-meadow.what: The outdoor festival grounds east of town, with a big top, stage, food stalls and a helter-skelter.

place-region-eastern-hills.title: Eastern Hills
place-region-eastern-hills.what: The open hills beyond the eastern settlements, forming the town’s eastern backdrop.

place-region-northern-mountains.title: Northern Mountains
place-region-northern-mountains.what: The mountain country beyond the alpine settlements and upper station, forming Eden’s northern horizon.

land-west-lake.title: West Lake
land-west-lake.what: The broad lake west of the Commons, edged by a pebble shore, willows and a jetty. Lakeside cabins and an inn stand along the northern shore. Approach the bank for a swim.

land-commons-shore-pond.title: Commons Pond
land-commons-shore-pond.what: The small pond just west of Commons Field. Its eastern bank is the nearby approach from the central gathering places.

land-park-pond.title: Park Pond
land-park-pond.what: The pond within Town Park, with a stone edge, reeds and a short jetty. It is distinct from the larger West Lake.

land-botanic-koi-pond.title: Koi Pond
land-botanic-koi-pond.what: The ornamental pond in the Botanic Garden, crossed by the red bridge and close to the tea pavilion.

land-southern-sea.title: Southern Sea
land-southern-sea.what: The open water beyond the harbour and resort beaches, stretching across Eden’s southern edge. The piers and lighthouse mark the waterfront.

land-canal.title: Town Canal
land-canal.what: The narrow waterway running through Canal Quarter between the east and west quays. The bridges connect the two residential banks.

land-golf-water-hazard.title: Golf Water Hazard
land-golf-water-hazard.what: The small water feature within the golf course, distinct from the lakes used as larger waterside destinations.

eden-library-1.title: Eden Library
eden-library-1.what: The village library offers reading tables, book-lined walls and quieter desk seats. It is the nearby library in Eden Village; the larger campus annex lies farther north.

parts.title: Reading Table Chair
parts.what: A chair at the west reading table.

eden-classroom-1.title: Eden Classroom
eden-classroom-1.what: The village classroom has a teacher’s desk facing rows of student desks and chairs. It is a compact place for lessons and small presentations.

parts.title: Front Student Chair
parts.what: A student chair facing the teaching area.

int-music-room.title: Eden Music Room
int-music-room.what: A music hall with audience benches and an adjoining gallery. Come here for an indoor musical gathering, or use the village bandstand for an outdoor one.

int-games-room.title: Eden Games Room
int-games-room.what: An indoor gathering room centered on a long table, with benches for shared games and conversation.

int-cafe.title: Eden Café
int-cafe.what: The village café has a counter and tables for coffee and conversation, near the dome quarter.

int-bakery.title: Eden Bakery
int-bakery.what: The bakery’s public shop fronts a separate storeroom. Enter the shop to visit the bakery rather than heading into its back storage area.

int-chapel.title: Village Chapel
int-chapel.what: A small chapel with pews in its nave, suited to a quiet indoor visit near the southern edge of Eden Village.

int-clinic.title: Village Clinic
int-clinic.what: The clinic’s ward is a quiet room with chairs and a washbasin, north of the main village homes.

int-bathhouse.title: Village Bathhouse
int-bathhouse.what: The village bathing room, separate from the clinic and bakery nearby.

int-potting-shed.title: Garden Workshop
int-potting-shed.what: A small workshop beside the village gardens, with a work area and tool storage.

eden-office-1.title: Eden Offices
eden-office-1.what: A three-level office building with ground-floor reception, offices above and a meeting room on the top floor. Choose the room and level for your visit.

parts.title: Offices
parts.what: A room on the upper floor.

parts.title: Top-Floor Meeting Room
parts.what: A room on the upper floor.

eden-dome.title: Eden Dome
eden-dome.what: The round domed gathering room at the heart of the dome quarter, beside the pergola court and café.

eden-pergola-court.title: Pergola Court
eden-pergola-court.what: An open sheltered court beside Eden Dome, for meeting and resting outdoors in the village.

eden-market-1.title: Eden Market Hall
eden-market-1.what: The covered market beside the village gardens and greenhouse, with small stalls for browsing and meeting.

eden-greenhouse.title: Village Greenhouse
eden-greenhouse.what: The greenhouse beside the market and gardens, a sheltered growing space within Eden Village.

eden-windmill.title: Village Windmill
eden-windmill.what: The windmill by the market is an easy landmark within Eden Village. The Farm Hamlet has a separate windmill farther west.

eden-observatory.title: Village Observatory
eden-observatory.what: The small observatory at the southern edge of Eden Village, beside the garden workshop. It is distinct from the Northern Observatory above the vineyard.

eden-bandstand.title: Eden Bandstand
eden-bandstand.what: A raised outdoor pavilion for music and small performances on the northern edge of the village.

eden-tea-house.title: Village Tea House
eden-tea-house.what: A tea pavilion near the offices, providing a quieter meeting place within Eden Village.

commons-pavilion.title: Commons Pavilion
commons-pavilion.what: The sheltered meeting pavilion near the center of Commons Field, close to the deck and shared kitchen.

commons-deck.title: Commons Deck
commons-deck.what: The open deck beside the central pavilion, a place to gather at the edge of Commons Field.

land-harbour-west-pier.title: Harbour West Pier
land-harbour-west-pier.what: The western harbour pier projects from the boardwalk over the sea. A bench at its outer end offers a seat with a waterfront view.

parts.title: Sea-View Bench
parts.what: The bench at the outer end of the West Pier.

land-harbour-east-pier.title: Harbour East Pier
land-harbour-east-pier.what: The eastern harbour pier extends farther into the sea from the boardwalk, opposite the West Pier.

land-harbour-boardwalk.title: Harbour Boardwalk
land-harbour-boardwalk.what: The long waterfront walkway connects the fish market, piers and route toward the lighthouse.

land-lighthouse-breakwater.title: Lighthouse Breakwater
land-lighthouse-breakwater.what: The coastal walkway leading toward the harbour lighthouse, beyond the two main piers.

land-west-lake-jetty.title: West Lake Jetty
land-west-lake-jetty.what: A short pier projecting over West Lake from its shore, useful for a waterside pause.

land-park-pond-jetty.title: Park Pond Jetty
land-park-pond-jetty.what: The small jetty over Park Pond, beside the stone-edged water and park lawns.

land-west-lake-pebble-shore.title: West Lake Pebble Shore
land-west-lake-pebble-shore.what: The stony edge of West Lake, where the land meets the water. This shore is the approach to the lake from the surrounding paths.

region-harbour-lighthouse.title: Harbour Lighthouse
region-harbour-lighthouse.what: The lighthouse at the outer edge of the harbour, marking the coast beyond the piers.

place-eden-gardens.what: The growing and garden area between the courtyard homes, greenhouse and southern village.

place-eden-stone-garden.what: A small stone garden between the classroom and library.

place-region-old-town-plaza.what: The civic square between the domed hall and bell tower.

place-region-old-town-market-street.title: Market Street
place-region-old-town-market-street.what: The shopping street along the southern edge of Old Town, leading toward the resort.

place-region-campus-quad.what: The lawn between East Hall and West Hall, with the library annex to the north and clock tower to the south.

worldAbout.title: Eden
worldAbout.what: A walkable town and surrounding countryside, with a central village, canal quarter, harbour, gardens, workshops, campus and woodland settlements. Named rooms, shores and seating help distinguish the next useful destination.
worldAbout.tour: Start at Commons Field for an outdoor meeting, or enter Eden Village for its classroom, library, café and music room. West Lake is the broad swimming destination west of the Commons; the small Commons Pond is closer to the field. Southward lie Town Park, the sports grounds and the harbour: follow the boardwalk to West Pier and its sea-view bench. Canal Quarter leads into Old Town and the seaside resort. Northward, the campus library, Makers’ Yard, Artists’ Village, Botanic Garden and vineyard offer more specialized visits. The Abbey and Courtyard Quarter lie west; the alpine stations and mountain restaurant lie beyond the northern settlements.
